_about: The shapes a System One decision model's reply may take — Cloudflare's Clef, Clef-flash and Clef-omni on Workers AI, asked through dyna.ink's relay (POST /decide, which answers { ok, model, ms, answers }) — as the decision seat's System One transport reads them (llm/decide-systemone.ts). WRITTEN BY HAND, NOT RECORDED: no real reply has been seen where this was written (Cloudflare's pages, its API and the relay were all out of reach), so these are the spellings third-party write-ups describe — a choice's `choice`, `probabilities` and `confidence`; a score's `score`, `legend`, `probabilities` and `confidence`; a noul's probability of yes — and the spellings the reader must refuse. `scripts/record-systemone.mjs` records one real reply per question shape beside them; once it has run, the reader is narrowed to the real spelling. Every case answers the questions the test builds: q1 a choice between molecule and compound (none_of_these last), q2 a score over rough < neat < clean, q3 a noul. Read by the core tests and by the e2e stub (e2e/servers.mjs), never by the page.

spelling-a._note: A map of probabilities by option key, the vendor's own pick and confidence; a score's legend place → level; a noul as an object with its value.

spelling-b._note: A list of { option, p }; a score's probabilities by place; a noul as a bare number.

spelling-c._note: A score's probabilities as a list of numbers in the levels' order; a noul's p_yes beside probabilities that agree.

disagree._note: Two spellings of one distribution that disagree, and two spellings of yes that disagree: both unanswered, never read one way.

vendor-none._note: A choice that answers with an option nobody offered (the vendor's own none): unanswered.

pick-only._note: A pick and a confidence with no distribution, and a score as a number alone: unanswered — a distribution made out of a pick is a guess.

pick-disagrees._note: The vendor's own pick is not where its distribution leads: the distribution is read, and the disagreement said.

off-sum._note: A distribution that sums to 2: normalised, and said.

not-asked._note: An answer to a question nobody asked, beside one that was: the stranger is left out and said.

no-answers._note: A reply with no answers map at all.
